problem: Consider a linear transformation $\,T\,.$ If $\,T(3{v}_{1}+7{v}_{2})=[\begin{aligned}13 \\ 5\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,T({v}_{2})=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$, then find $\,T({v}_{1}).$
